name: nle-timeline
does: THIS video's real editing timeline (its captions, graphics and cards by layer, cutout windows, the cut with graded thumbnails and camera keyframes, the voice with its J-cuts, the sound blips) opens empty over the shot, floods in from the playhead on the words, holds with a real running timecode, then folds to a line and retracts into the playhead.
use_when: 'you'd think this took hours in an editor', 'how much work an edit is', the video about its own edit; once a video, after most of the edit exists (it draws the edit as it is)
inputs: nothing by hand: gen.py draws it from edit.py, timeline.json, the voice and clean.mp4 (rerun it after pasting the FX entry, after the mix, after any cut, caption or FX change)
the beats the lanes flood in on (T: seconds after A or the spoken words) and where the panel sits (PANEL, above the eyes in every shot of the window)

notes.TITLE: the sequence name in the panel's tab; "" = the project's folder name
notes.T: open, captions, video, audio are beats (seconds after A or words): the caption lane floods in on captions, the video lanes on video, the voice, keyframes and sound on audio; fold is a length (s before B)
notes.LANE_AT: lane -> [a key of T, stagger s]; these name T's keys, not spoken words
notes.PANEL: 1010 x about 350 px; keep it above the eyes in every shot of the window

generators.when: you paste the FX entry (its own block shows selected), after the mix, after any change to the cut, the captions or the FX list

needs: rerun gen.py once this entry is in edit.FX, and again after the mix

sfx.name: clicks-run
sfx.what: the edit floods in (placed by its start)
